descriptor.retrieval_description: The object is a fabric-covered case with curved lateral surfaces suitable for opposing pad contact. The grip band encounters soft woven textile stretched over semi-rigid shell walls.
descriptor.contact_region: Left and right lateral curved surfaces of the case within the centered horizontal grasp band.
descriptor.visible_surface_condition: Clean, smooth, and uniformly textured woven fabric with a zipper seam running along the top edge.
descriptor.local_geometry: Smooth convex curvature across the lateral faces, tapering slightly towards the top with a central zipper seam interruption overhead.
descriptor.uncertainty: Low uncertainty regarding surface material and geometry within the lateral grasp band.
